speaker: Doctor
text: I notice you haven't provided the patient's initial symptoms or history yet. To begin our examination, please describe your current medical history, specifically regarding any recent fever, weight loss, or night sweats.

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that history. Given your significant weight loss and night sweats, have you noticed any swelling or lumps in your neck or armpits, specifically supraclavicular nodes? Also, have you experienced any changes in your bowel habits or stool color?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Lymphoma. REQUEST IMAGES: CT_Abdomen_Pelvis, CT_Chest. REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count with Differential, LDH, and Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate.
